entities.name: Jasmin Hukić
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Jasmin Hukić is a Bosnian retired professional basketball player who last played for Ilirija of the Slovenian League. He also represented the Bosnia and Herzegovina national basketball team. Standing at 2.04 m, he plays at the small forward and power forward positions.
